scope.description: A leader that is processing a configurationChangeFuture and whose LogStore.StoreLogs returns an error for that entry.
assumptions: A LogStore.StoreLogs error is an admitted input: dispatchLogs itself handles it by responding the error and setting state to Follower, so a transient store error is a handled, not fatal, condition.
The configuration entry index is assigned by dispatchLogs before StoreLogs is attempted.
excluded: Corruption semantics beyond StoreLogs returning a non-nil error
Protocol versions below 2 where the entry type is LogRemovePeerDeprecated

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: One transient LogStore.StoreLogs failure is injected at the real LogStore boundary; no target source is modified
The harness is an added _test.go file in the captured package; observation is emitted as CA_EVENT JSON

plan_uncertainties: A single failing StoreLogs timing is observed; other store failure points are outside this direct check
The admitted operation runs in a single-voter cluster, so downstream effects on a multi-voter quorum are not exercised here
grounding_unresolved: Whether a production LogStore (e.g. BoltDB) can surface a transient StoreLogs error while the process continues
Only one failure timing (whole StoreLogs call fails) is exercised in this direct check; the general set of failure points is covered by the wider investigation
Whether a production LogStore can return a transient StoreLogs error while the process continues
